name: Wallace Lozier
role: New Yorker in Medora, friend of J. R. Grymes
bio: Wallace Lozier of New York came to Medora in January 1885 as a friend of J. R. Grymes. He shot in the Bad Lands Gun Club's first rifle contest in late February 1885 and brought in wild brant with Grymes in May 1885.

moments.label: Arrived from New York as Grymes' friend
Brought in wild brant with Grymes

mentions: Wallace Lozier, of New York, a friend of J. R. Grymes, is here visiting the latter. He will take up his residence in Medora, and doubtless make a good citizen.
The Bad Lands Gun Club Shoot.
Messrs Grymes and Lozier brought in a fine specimen of wild brant last Sunday, consisting of a hen and seven chicks.
